plan.goal: Ship a verified changelog, X thread, and trailer for honojs/hono v4.13.12

steps.title: Read the release range
steps.detail: Pull commits, compare v4.13.11...v4.13.12, merged PRs, and linked issues via the GitHub API.

steps.title: Draft the release story
steps.detail: Turn the structured change list into notes.md and a launch thread. Every claim must cite a SHA or PR.

steps.title: Ground every claim
steps.detail: Reject bullets that are not supported by the compare payload. Send the writer back if anything is invented.

steps.title: Render the trailer
steps.detail: Storyboard verified copy into slides and encode trailer.mp4. Fall back if ffmpeg fails.

steps.title: Assemble the kit
steps.detail: Write notes.md, thread.txt, trailer.mp4, and evidence.json. Persist state so a failed run can resume.

risks: GitHub API rate limits on unauthenticated compares
Hallucinated features in the first writer pass
ffmpeg encoder or font failures on the first render

officialRelease.name: v4.13.12
officialRelease.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(build): keep internal types private in bundled d.ts and avoid a self-referencing JSX.IntrinsicElements in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5485
* test(build): type-check the bundled declarations from a consumer project in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5486
* fix(etag): correctly match mixed-case header name in retainedHeader option in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5475
* fix(jsx): add px to numeric gridGap, gridRowGap and gridColumnGap in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5487
* fix(combine): return a Response from a short-circuiting middleware in some() in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5391
* chore(deps): upgrade vite-plus to 1.0.0 in https://github.com/honojs/hono/pull/5464

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/honojs/hono/compare/v4.13.11...v4.13.12
